notes: no_other_pos: limited to Brightmoor material. As extracted it treated Hollin's legitimate header card (Campaign C) as a breach, which would fail every compliant shelf.
summer_saver_wobbler: removed the 'does not cover a product' clause. A hanging wobbler always overlaps the shelf below; standards 5.3 is a judgement the photo cannot settle reliably.
After GPT-6.2 Sol data review: added posm_does_not_hide_display for standards 5.3, scoped and defined as in Campaign B, so A and B apply 5.3 the same way.
After GPT-6.2 Sol data review: packs_faced_up, no_damaged_packs, clean_shelf: limited to Brightmoor packs and their shelf.

checks.requirement: The campaign range is together in one continuous block on the eye-level middle shelf.
checks.question: Check where the Brightmoor campaign packs are placed.
checks.compliant: Original Roast, Dark Roast and Decaf are together in one block on the middle shelf, with no campaign packs on another shelf.
checks.not_compliant: A campaign pack is on another shelf, or the range is split into separate blocks.

checks.requirement: The range runs left to right: Original Roast, Dark Roast, Decaf.
checks.question: Check the left-to-right order of the Brightmoor range.
checks.compliant: Original Roast is leftmost, followed by Dark Roast, then Decaf.
checks.not_compliant: The three products appear in a different order.

checks.requirement: All three campaign SKUs are present with their minimum facings.
checks.question: Check the visible facings of each Brightmoor campaign SKU.
checks.compliant: There are at least three blue Original Roast facings, two black Dark Roast facings and two green Decaf facings.
checks.not_compliant: A campaign SKU is missing or has fewer than its required visible facings.

checks.requirement: There are no product-width gaps within the Brightmoor block.
checks.question: Check for empty spaces within the Brightmoor block.
checks.compliant: No space of one product width or more exposes the shelf back or base within the block.
checks.not_compliant: A space of one product width or more exposes the shelf back or base within the block.

checks.requirement: No other brand's products sit inside or between Brightmoor packs.
checks.question: Check whether another brand's products interrupt the Brightmoor block.
checks.compliant: Only Brightmoor products are within the block; other brands may sit beside it.
checks.not_compliant: Another brand's product sits inside or between Brightmoor packs.

checks.requirement: Brightmoor Hazelnut and other Brightmoor SKUs outside this campaign are not displayed.
checks.question: Check the bay for Brightmoor products other than Original Roast, Dark Roast and Decaf.
checks.compliant: No Brightmoor Hazelnut or other non-campaign Brightmoor product is displayed.
checks.not_compliant: Brightmoor Hazelnut or another non-campaign Brightmoor product is displayed.

checks.requirement: Brightmoor packs are pulled forward, upright and front-facing.
checks.question: Check the position and orientation of Brightmoor packs. Consider only the Brightmoor packs and their shelf; ignore other brands and the jars.
checks.compliant: Packs sit at the front edge of the shelf, stand upright and show their front labels to shoppers.
checks.not_compliant: A pack is set back, on its side, upside down or turned with its side panel facing shoppers.

checks.requirement: No visibly damaged Brightmoor packs remain on display.
checks.question: Check Brightmoor packs for visible damage. Consider only the Brightmoor packs and their shelf; ignore other brands and the jars.
checks.compliant: Displayed packs are not crushed, torn or opened.
checks.not_compliant: A displayed pack is crushed, torn or opened.

checks.requirement: The Brightmoor shelf is free of litter, spillage and loose packaging.
checks.question: Check the Brightmoor shelf for litter, spillage or loose packaging. Consider only the Brightmoor packs and their shelf; ignore other brands and the jars.
checks.compliant: None is present on the shelf.
checks.not_compliant: Litter, spillage or loose packaging is present on the shelf.

checks.requirement: Original Roast has a visible yellow £3.50 promotional shelf-edge label directly below it.
checks.question: Check the shelf-edge label directly below Original Roast.
checks.compliant: A fully visible yellow promotional label directly below Original Roast reads £3.50.
checks.not_compliant: The label is missing, covered, misplaced, not yellow or does not read £3.50.

checks.requirement: Dark Roast has a visible white £4.00 shelf-edge label directly below it.
checks.question: Check the shelf-edge label directly below Dark Roast.
checks.compliant: A fully visible white label directly below Dark Roast reads £4.00.
checks.not_compliant: The label is missing, covered, misplaced, not white or does not read £4.00.

checks.requirement: Decaf has a visible white £4.00 shelf-edge label directly below it.
checks.question: Check the shelf-edge label directly below Decaf.
checks.compliant: A fully visible white label directly below Decaf reads £4.00.
checks.not_compliant: The label is missing, covered, misplaced, not white or does not read £4.00.

checks.requirement: Exactly one Summer Saver wobbler hangs from the shelf edge directly below Original Roast.
checks.question: Check the Summer Saver wobbler on the Brightmoor shelf edge.
checks.compliant: Exactly one wobbler reading "Summer Saver" hangs from the shelf edge directly below Original Roast.
checks.not_compliant: The wobbler is missing, duplicated, has different wording or is not below Original Roast.

checks.requirement: The Summer Saver wobbler is the only Brightmoor point-of-sale material with the Brightmoor range.
checks.question: Check the Brightmoor block and its shelf edge for Brightmoor point-of-sale material other than the Summer Saver wobbler, including material from earlier Brightmoor campaigns. Other brands' material elsewhere in the bay is not part of this check.
checks.compliant: The Summer Saver wobbler is the only Brightmoor point-of-sale material on the Brightmoor shelf.
checks.not_compliant: Other Brightmoor point-of-sale material, such as a "NEW" strip or earlier-campaign material, is displayed with the Brightmoor range.

checks.requirement: Brightmoor point-of-sale material does not hide a Brightmoor product name or shelf-edge price.
checks.question: Check whether Brightmoor point-of-sale material hides a Brightmoor product or price. Covering means hiding a Brightmoor product's name or a Brightmoor shelf-edge price. A wobbler hanging over the shelf below, or material touching a pack's edge, is not covering. Other brands' material is not part of this check.
checks.compliant: Every Brightmoor product name and shelf-edge price remains visible.
checks.not_compliant: Brightmoor point-of-sale material hides a Brightmoor product name or shelf-edge price.

not_checkable.requirement: Rotate stock so the shortest-dated packs are at the front.
Prices are correct at the till.

not_checkable.rule: Brief: Campaign period and Display set-up deadline
not_checkable.requirement: Set up before opening on 31 May 2027 and maintain the display for the campaign period.
Remove expired campaign material on the day its campaign ends.
Make the display look inviting and premium.
Replenish the Brightmoor block at least twice daily.

not_checkable.rule: Brief: Objective; Commercial terms and reporting
not_checkable.requirement: Achieve the sales target, administer the fixture fee and report weekly sales.

not_checkable.rule: Standards 6.1–6.3; Brief: Commercial terms and reporting
not_checkable.requirement: Conduct scheduled audits, upload or retake audit photographs, and obtain the store manager's sign-off.
